postSubject: Yeah. I know. ''Oh you got banned? Boo-hoo. Go on with your imaginary problems. You are so lucky and should be happy. Do not get so sad over stuff. Go on with life.''I was angry on there. I just do not like it when I get teased with answers that are not impossible to answer.If this made you angry through what I said about the marketing, know that I did see the ''Make A Difference'' thread. I know what you went through and I understand the stress. I was only angry because I am the kind of person that hates theories. The reason being is that the answers we need are right there, and it feels like you are just teasing us.I am not asking for a ban lift. I just wanted to display why I feel angry. I could go deeper, but that would make it worse (AKA: the VERY reason I hate theories).Just know that I do in-fact love this story, and for that reason I get irritated when a few answers are teased.For the record: I do not care that I was banned. Just know why I said these things and that I am sorry.
commentSubject: It's OK to be angry, everyone gets angry, but you need to learn to control it better. Sometimes the louder you scream, the less people will listen. You expressed yourself very well in this post.
